target.title: fix(qqbot): add actionable setup error guidance
target.body:
## Summary

Add shared QQBot setup guidance to the user-facing errors that currently leave users at a dead end when credentials or platform access fail.

## Issue/Motivation

Fixes #65868.

Current main still emits terse QQBot failures in the exact paths called out by the issue:
- missing gateway/outbound credentials only say `QQBot not configured (missing appId or clientSecret)`;
- token endpoint failures expose the raw Open Platform JSON without telling the user which OpenClaw settings to fix;
- API/network errors include the low-level failure but no setup path.

## Changes

- Add a small shared QQBot setup-guidance helper that points users to `QQBOT_APP_ID`, `QQBOT_CLIENT_SECRET`, and the QQBot setup docs.
- Use that guidance for missing gateway/outbound credentials.
- Append the guidance to token endpoint failures when `access_token` is absent.
- Append the guidance to structured QQBot API errors and network errors.
- Add regression tests for token, structured API, and network error messages.

## Testing

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run extensions/qqbot/src/engine/api/token.test.ts extensions/qqbot/src/engine/api/api-client.test.ts` — passed (2 files, 11 tests)
- `pnpm tsgo:extensions` — passed
- `pnpm exec oxlint --tsconfig config/tsconfig/oxlint.extensions.json extensions/qqbot/src/engine/api/token.ts extensions/qqbot/src/engine/api/api-client.ts extensions/qqbot/src/engine/config/setup-guidance.ts extensions/qqbot/src/engine/gateway/gateway.ts extensions/qqbot/src/engine/messaging/outbound.ts extensions/qqbot/src/engine/api/token.test.ts extensions/qqbot/src/engine/api/api-client.test.ts` — passed (0 warnings, 0 errors)
- `git diff --cached --check` — passed
- staged diff secret scan — passed; no credential-looking additions

Note: full `pnpm lint:extensions` was attempted twice after installing dependencies, but timed out locally after 300s and 600s respectively, so I used the equivalent targeted oxlint command for the changed QQBot files.

## What Problem This Solves

QQBot users hitting missing credentials, invalid Open Platform token responses, or API/network failures now get actionable recovery guidance in the error itself instead of only a terse/raw failure. The message names the exact OpenClaw environment variables to configure and links to the QQBot channel docs.

## Evidence

- Source-level repro on current main before this change:
  - `extensions/qqbot/src/engine/gateway/gateway.ts` threw only `QQBot not configured (missing appId or clientSecret)`.
  - `extensions/qqbot/src/engine/messaging/outbound.ts` returned the same terse message for text/media sends.
  - `extensions/qqbot/src/engine/api/token.ts` threw `Failed to get access_token: ${JSON.stringify(data)}` when the token response omitted `access_token`.
  - `extensions/qqbot/src/engine/api/api-client.ts` emitted low-level API/network errors without setup guidance.
- Regression tests assert the new messages include `QQBOT_APP_ID`, `QQBOT_CLIENT_SECRET`, and `https://docs.openclaw.ai/channels/qqbot` for token, structured API, and network failures.
- Validation commands run locally:
  - `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run extensions/qqbot/src/engine/api/token.test.ts extensions/qqbot/src/engine/api/api-client.test.ts` — passed (2 files, 11 tests)
  - `pnpm tsgo:extensions` — passed
  - targeted oxlint on all changed QQBot files — passed (0 warnings, 0 errors)
  - `git diff --cached --check` — passed
  - staged diff secret scan — passed
